name: Agriculture and Farming
description: Starter pack for farms and food producers: animal care, equipment, crop cycles, chemical compliance and insurance.

definitions.title: Daily feeding and water check
definitions.note: Feed, water and visually check all livestock.
steps: Log any animal that needs attention

definitions.title: Daily livestock health check
definitions.note: Watch for lameness, appetite changes or signs of illness.

definitions.title: Weekly irrigation check
definitions.note: Check irrigation lines, pumps and soil moisture.

definitions.title: Weekly equipment check
definitions.note: Inspect tractors, implements and tools before the week's work.

definitions.title: Monthly fence check
definitions.note: Walk the fence lines and repair weak spots.

definitions.title: Monthly chemical inventory
definitions.note: Log pesticide and herbicide inventory and verify storage conditions.

definitions.title: Quarterly vaccination schedule
definitions.note: Run the vaccination program and update herd records.

definitions.title: Planting plan
definitions.note: Finalize the planting plan, seed orders and field rotation.

definitions.title: Harvest plan review
definitions.note: Review the harvest plan, equipment readiness and labour.

definitions.title: Chemical storage compliance audit
definitions.note: Audit chemical storage, signage and safety sheets.

definitions.title: Farm insurance review
definitions.note: Review property, liability and crop insurance before renewal.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc equipment repair
definitions.note: Breakdown or urgent repair - set the due date when creating it.
